notes.title: One Day to Launch! | Early Access Preview (Part 2)
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, the countdown begins - [b]just one day left[/b] before Stario: Haven Tower launches in Early Access![/p][p]For anyone who missed the previous post, here’s a quick reminder on pricing: the EA version will launch at [b]$13.99 USD (launch discount $12.59)[/b], with a [b]10% launch discount for two weeks[/b].[/p][p]Since the demo first went live at the end of March, more than [b]51,000 players[/b] have tried it out. Thank you all for your incredible support! With the demo having completed its mission, [u][b]we’ll be taking it offline today.[/b][/u][/p][p]As mentioned before, Demo save files will not carry over to the EA version. But don’t worry — [b]even if you’ve already built a full 12-layer tower, the new EA build is heavily reworked and won’t feel repetitive[/b]. We’ve made big changes to early progression, so the experience will feel fresh and rewarding.[/p][p]In our last post, we previewed the [b]Miracle Tower[/b] system. If you missed it, check it out here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3209750/view/547872593745544317"][/dynamiclink]Today, let’s dive into three more key features arriving in Early Access: [b]Ritual Platforms, Trade, and the Wishboard system[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/b47a702fc2add1bd12cbfd4e839e8f021f1404f5.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Perform Rituals, Summon Disasters[/b][/h2][p]In EA, players won’t just endure disasters, you can [b]summon them[/b]. The key is the [b]Ritual Platform[/b], unlocked through the Tech Tree.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/c8d79a78e741ad5549c8deb20698f0e76510963f.png"][/img][/p][p]Build one, and you’ll gain access to three categories of rituals:[/p][list][*][p][b]Aether Rituals[/b]: Influence climate and environment. Yes, you can deliberately call down endless Blizzards or perpetual Mist. (Of course, not every Aether Ritual is about summoning Disasters, we’ll let you discover the rest in game.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vita Rituals[/b]: Affect your Towertizens directly. For example, the Migrana Ritual expands their working range, while the Ignira Ritual increases cold resistance. But each benefit comes with a cost, it’s up to you to decide if it’s worth it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fabrik Rituals[/b]: Temporarily change how your tower functions. For instance, during the Ourophira Ritual, storage between the base and top layer becomes fully connected, allowing automatic transfers.[/p][/*][/list][p]Rituals consume resources to stay active. When supplies run out, the Ritual ends. Whether you maintain long-term buffs or opt for short bursts is up to your strategy.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Trade with the Skyfaring Turtles[/b][/h2][p]Even in this collapsing world, travelers still roam the skies on the backs of giant turtles. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/3bc5f2435f87fcfa24428163d9b242356292a126.png"][/img][/p][p]By building a [b]Turtle Port[/b], you can unlock the [b]Trade[/b] system.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/f73bdad23eeb0e597bbb2d3d77da23157444a306.png"][/img][/p][p]When a turtle arrives, you can barter based on your current inventory. Choose between [b]manual trade[/b], carefully planning each exchange, or [b]automatic trade[/b], letting turtles become long-term partners who always exchange goods upon arrival.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]The Wishboard: Hear from Your Towertizens[/b][/h2][p]Not all Towertizens were born in the tower. Some once lived in the underground cities and remember the vast lands of old. But for many born here, the tower is their only home.[/p][p]As their sense of belonging grows, Towertizens will leave requests on the [b]Wishboard[/b]. These wishes range from small personal comforts to quirky dreams:[/p][p]A quiet hermit longing for solitude.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/241bfd7b096324228f69f9bcb62fb5bf3bbff92f.png"][/img][/p][p]A food lover willing to give up everything for better meals.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/f72a7e467e67cdfff2cb2f2046eabe5ba47e8414.png"][/img][/p][p]An eccentric, who only wants a unique pet...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/7f5ab7583125ae25436c42af6f3b23bb6466b5e8.png"][/img][/p][p]Fulfilling these wishes not only shapes your tower into a true home but may also earn you precious gems as thanks.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]More Difficulty Modes and Achievements[/b][/h2][p]EA also introduces [b]three difficulty modes[/b], adjusting material costs, disaster intensity, and resource efficiency. Choose the pace and challenge that suit your playstyle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/9ae550f137dfc5167b3dc5e8669fb30e2d1340a7.png"][/img][/p][p]And yes, there’s also a brand-new [b]achievement system[/b]. We won’t spoil the details here, but we hope you enjoy discovering them for yourself.[/p][p][/p][h2]See You at TGS![/h2][p]We’re also happy to share that [b]Stario: Haven Tower[/b] will be at [b]Tokyo Game Show 2025[/b]. From [b]September 25 to 28[/b], players can try out the EA version at our booth: [b]Hall 11, C51[/b]. If you’re attending, come by and say hi![/p][p]We’ve shared plenty of development details and inspirations in past updates. If you’d like to explore more, here are some links:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3209750/announcements/detail/506191016530805152"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3209750/announcements/detail/613168715156947543"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3209750/announcements/detail/503957045122172856"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3209750/announcements/detail/503960594326487629"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3209750/view/788814720766313065"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3209750/view/547872593745544317"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you’d like to share your thoughts, feel free to comment below or join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/sfXVUFRzP7"][u][b]official Discord[/b][/u][/url] to chat with fellow Tower Masters![/p]

notes.title: Stario: Haven Tower launches in EA on Sept 25 | New Content Preview Pt.1
notes.content: [p]Hello, everyone! Thank you for waiting![/p][p]At today’s Convergence Showcase, we finally revealed the release date for [i]Stario: Haven Tower:[/i][/p][p][b]The game will launch in Early Access on September 25 at 8:00 PM PDT, priced at $13.99 (launch price $12.59), with a 10% launch discount for two weeks.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/GIlOQQvWiXI"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The [b]Demo[/b] is scheduled to close on [b]September 25[/b]. If you haven’t tried it yet, there is still a chance to give the game a try:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387080/_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][u][b]Please note that Demo save files will not carry over[/b][/u] to the Early Access version. In [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3209750/view/788814720766313065"]our previous post[/url], we explained in detail why we had to drop save transfer support. While we truly wished to preserve your progress, the game has gone through multiple major balance adjustments. After evaluating the compatibility between versions, we ultimately decided to let go of supporting save transfer.[/p][p][/p][p]That said, with all the optimizations and overhauls we’ve made, the Early Access version you’ll soon play is a significantly improved experience. We believe it will be more fun and more polished than the Demo, and we sincerely hope you enjoy exploring this carefully refined world![/p][p][/p][h1][b]What’s new in the EA version compared to the Demo?[/b][/h1][p]The Early Access version will include the [b]entire main storyline[/b], unlocking the full [b]Tech Tree[/b] and [b]Tower Construction Progress[/b], along with three difficulty modes and dozens of hours of gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p]But we know many of you may still have questions, such as: [i]What exactly does the full tech tree contain? How high can the tower reach? And aside from the content already teased in the Demo, what brand-new features will the Early Access version bring?[/i][/p][p][/p][p]To answer these, here is an overview summarizing all the new content included in Early Access. We’ll go through each of these points in detail together![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/b47a702fc2add1bd12cbfd4e839e8f021f1404f5.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Miracle Tower: Milestones in the Sky[/b][/h2][p]Disasters may shatter the buildings, but it is often the endless unknown that truly inspires fear. To keep their faith from eroding, people must record distance from the earth, and the achievements along their ascent.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s why we’ve designed the [b]Miracle Tower[/b]: a way to build lasting milestones throughout your long journey toward the sky.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/9e5772181ad2ee7f7f500a8a207bee25108081a9.gif"][/img][/p][p]Each atmospheric zone features its own unique Miracle Tower. Once completed, it not only strengthens the faith of your Towertizens, but more importantly, [b]an activated Miracle Tower forces disasters to retreat[/b].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Cross the Zones, Reach the End of Sky[/b][/h2][p]In the Early Access version, the game will feature [b]six atmospheric zones[/b]. Beyond the Sand Zone and Mist Zone already seen in the Demo, players can now ascend into the[b] Rain Zone, [/b]the[b] Frost Zone, [/b]the[b] Clear Zone[/b], and ultimately reach the journey’s end in the [b]Star Zone[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Each zone carries its own climate and resources to uncover: mantas will drift through the Rain Zone, while great whales will roam the Clear Zone.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/dbb84902c14ab549cec7f3cb9df6c91c58f9c5f5.png"][/img][/p][p]Yet just as the whispers of mist gnaw away at willpower in the Mist Zone, new crises will surface as you climb higher, threatening the lives of the Towertizens. Unlocking new technologies will certainly help, but how you arrange production layouts, manage logistics, and keep Towertizens safe will still depend on optimizing your own strategies.[/p][p][/p][p]At the same time, [b]we’ve made major adjustments to resource production[/b]. In the Demo, many resources could only be obtained in specific zones. For example, Quartz could not be harvested from Jellyfish Bay in the Sand Zone, yielding zero efficiency.[/p][p][/p][p]For the Early Access version, we completely overhauled this system to offer players greater freedom and more diverse options. [u][b]All resource-gathering buildings can now be freely constructed at any altitude.[/b][/u] However, each zone still retains its own specialties, [b]with certain resources only reaching peak efficiency in specific atmospheric zones[/b]. How to plan and optimize your layouts will once again be left in your hands.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Unlock the Tech Tree, Face the Disasters[/b][/h2][p]The tech tree, already introduced in the Demo, will now allow players to ultimately unlock [b]more than seventy buildings[/b]. But this isn’t simply a matter of opening every node at once.[/p][p][/p][p]As one of the game’s core mechanics, the tech tree shapes both pacing and strategy, and so in the EA version we have not only expanded its content but also rebalanced its structure.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/669cfbfb38d1e2a508d311225fcdfd6b95158325.png"][/img][/p][p]Unlock orders and prerequisites for each tech have been carefully reconsidered. Nodes in the tech tree have also been adjusted. For instance, during the Demo, [b]Tower Rebuild [/b]was locked behind a late-game tech, but after hearing your feedback, we’ve decided to [u][b]remove it from the tree altogether and make it available from the start[/b][/u]. This way, players can freely adjust their production layouts throughout the game and face early decisions with lower cost.[/p][p][/p][p]The disaster system, also previewed in the Demo, has been redesigned based on community feedback. We’ve refreshed the visual design of the four disaster totems, adjusted their stats, and rebalanced their duration and effects on the Toweritizens.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/f94b06f58dd77ca50334f49c001b8c91cc1f4bc9.png"][/img][/p][p]As the game’s central challenge, disasters should not merely break players’ flow. Rather, they would be woven into the experience itself. From barely surviving them in the beginning, to gradually mastering them, and eventually even learning to summon disasters on purpose.[/p][p][/p][p]As for how exactly you may summon a disaster… we’ll leave that story for next time.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Due to space limits, we’ll save many of the brand-new systems and mechanics for the next post. However, we’ve already shared some development previews in earlier updates, and we’ve put them all together here for those who are interested:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3209750/announcements/detail/506191016530805152"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3209750/announcements/detail/613168715156947543"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3209750/announcements/detail/503957045122172856"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3209750/announcements/detail/503960594326487629"][/dynamiclink]If you have any thoughts or feedback, feel free to leave a comment below, or join our official [url="https://discord.com/invite/sfXVUFRzP7"][u]Discord[/u][/url] server to chat with fellow Tower Masters![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Stario: Haven Tower to Reveal Early Access Release Info on September 18
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]Since the Steam Next Fest, we’ve been hearing the same question again and again across different platforms: [i]“When will the game finally launch?”[/i] As a small indie team, we’re truly grateful for all the love and attention you’ve shown [i]Stario: Haven Tower[/i]![/p][p]Over the past months we’ve been fully focused on wrapping up development—working day and night on the final stretch of testing and polishing. And now, the moment has finally come to share some exciting news: [i]Stario: Haven Tower[/i] will be featured on [b]September 18 [/b]at the [b]Convergence Showcase[/b], which will also be streamed on IGN. During the Convergence Showcase, we’ll premiere a brand-new Early Access trailer and announce details on the EA release date and pricing. We’ll save the rest of the surprises for the event itself, so please stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/3ea5c0d297286064fa4b61f1da0fb8a303d4c08b.png"][/img][/p][p]In the meantime, from [b]Sept 15 to Sept 29[/b], [i]Stario: Haven Tower[/i] will also be featured in the [b]Steam Publisher Sale by XD[/b]. If you haven’t tried our demo yet, this is a great chance to download it and give it a spin before launch: [/p][p] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387080"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]Why Early Access?[/b][/h2][p]We know that in recent years, the tag “Early Access” hasn’t always carried the most positive impression. Honestly, we also had doubts at first about whether choosing Early Access might affect how people see our game.[/p][p]But after much discussion, we decided to stick with this path. Not only because we believe the game has room to grow, but also because we want to shape it together with you, our community. With your feedback and support, we hope to refine and expand the tower into something closer to everyone’s ideal vision.[/p][p]That said, “Early Access” doesn’t mean cutting corners. The EA release already includes [b]the full main storyline, three difficulty modes, and dozens of hours of content[/b]. You’ll be able to unlock the complete tech tree and tower progression, and climb all the way to the very top.[/p][p]For us, Early Access represents both our vision and our honesty: [i]Stario: Haven Tower[/i] still has a long way to go before it becomes the “perfect version” we imagine [i](if such a thing even exists for any developer)[/i]. There are still many possibilities waiting ahead—and we’d love to explore them together with you.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Will Demo Saves Carry Over?[/b][/h2][p]Unfortunately, [b][u]save data from the demo will not be compatible with the EA version[/u][/b]. This was a tough call—we really wanted to keep everyone’s progress, but the game has gone through major changes based on both our internal testing and feedback from the community.[/p][p]Sometimes we added new features; other times, we realized that a system simply wasn’t working and had to rebuild it from scratch. Since Next Fest, we’ve also made extensive changes to balance: recipe formulas, resource ratios in each area, buff types and values for different tower sections, and more. As a resource-management and city-building game, these numbers are central to the overall experience. Adjusting them is key to making the game more diverse and giving players more freedom in how they approach the climb.[/p][p]Because of all this, we had to let go of save compatibility—but we hope you’ll find that starting fresh in the EA version makes for an even richer and more rewarding experience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/9557d877f3219a245f21bfcdd8e7ef2b9c4c6f70.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h2][p]We’ll be sharing more details on what the EA version includes, along with the new features we’ve been working on, in our September 18 update post.[/p][p]If you run into any issues while playing the demo, or if you’d like to chat with other players, feel free to join our [b]official Discord server[/b]: [url="https://discord.com/invite/sfXVUFRzP7"]https://discord.com/invite/sfXVUFRzP7[/url][/p][p]We also share dev logs and behind-the-scenes updates on our socials—follow along if you’d like to see more ⬇️⬇️⬇️[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #3: From Sketch to Skyline - How does concept art turn into a real game?
notes.content:
[p]Hello, everyone![/p][p]Today, we’d like to share a glimpse into the design of some of the buildings you’ll encounter in the game.[/p][p]From the simplest Hut to the many varieties of Brick Factories, bringing these structures from concept art to what you finally see in-game is never a straightforward copy-and-paste—it’s all about trial, adjustment, and finding balance.[/p][h2]🏚 Refining the Roofs[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/4b38e08b1604987740fd870c1cce22f73bf98861.png"][/img][/p][p]The Hut’s roof went through many experiments in concept: fabric, bamboo, even worn bricks. In the end, we settled on a clean, unified tile design—easier on the eyes, and more in line with the game’s overall art style.[/p][p]Its upgraded version—the Brick House—also went through several design passes. We wanted it to have its own character without looking out of place. After multiple iterations, the version you see in-game today was finally chosen.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/65d79b1b4903726862511105a46aaa417bb3bbd0.png"][/img][/p][h2]🎨 Crafting the Brick [/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/dbd0382283574da235a771a4325a3cdcc71479fb.png"][/img][/p][p]Brick Factories are one of the key industrial foundations in the Vertical Kingdom. Their colors were fine-tuned across many rounds of testing: How should we bring out the metallic texture of certain parts? How bright should the base tones be so that each type feels distinct yet visually comfortable? After plenty of tweaks, we landed on a palette that felt just right.[/p][p][/p][h2]⚙ Balancing Art and Performance[/h2][p]
One of the biggest challenges in turning concept art into in-game models is ensuring smooth performance. Overly intricate decorations may look stunning on paper, but they also drive up polygon counts and risk slowing things down. Simplify too much, however, and you lose the beauty that gives each building its charm. Finding the right balance meant countless tests and adjustments.[/p][p]Every building you see in the game—each tower segment, and even the strange little creatures drifting in the sky—has gone through its own series of unseen iterations, all in pursuit of harmony between aesthetics and performance.[/p][p]And this is just the beginning! The EA version will bring even more distinctive buildings for you to discover—so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/f81e1164ce500755c61ec62196245efacb1b7a57.png"][/img][/p][h3]Lastly—don’t forget to wishlist us![/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3209750/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Devlog#2 Ritual Platform & Vertical Garden Spoiler
notes.content: [p]Hi folks! The game’s development has now entered its final stages, and we’re really hoping to get it into your hands soon![/p][p]In our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3209750/view/613168715156947542?l=english"]last post[/url], we gave you a brief sneak peek at some of the new content coming in the EA version — today, we’d like to share a more detailed look with you.[/p][p][/p][h2]Ritual Platform[/h2][p]The Tower has more secrets to share, and today’s reveal is… the Ritual Platform![/p][p]In our last post, we mentioned that the EA version will unlock the “Ritual Platform,” allowing you to change the gameplay through rituals and Faiths.[/p][p]You’ll be able to unlock the Ritual Platform fairly early in the game. Like the Jellyfish Bay, it’s a special structure converted from your existing tower — but unlike it, the Ritual Platform requires three vertical floors.[/p][p]By unlociking the Platform, you can freely select and combine different types of rituals to match your city-building strategy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/34b96981683c51d577e1503e2dbc12e7f369226c.png"][/img][/p][p] Three Ritual Categories:[/p][list][*][p][b]Aether Rituals[/b] (e.g., Levia Ritual): Lightens gravity, allowing buildings to extend farther and carriers to work with ease.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vita Rituals[/b] (e.g., Migrana Ritual): Enables citizens to work across greater vertical distances.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fabrik Rituals[/b] (e.g., Pendara Ritual): Boosts production the farther structures are built from the core.[/p][/*][/list][p]Rituals can be combined for layered effects — but watch out! Many come with “reasonable” trade-offs.[/p][p]For example, Levia Ritual weakens gravity, but also slows down pipeline transport efficiency. A blessing for manpower-focused towers, but [i]perhaps[/i] not ideal for logistics-heavy builds.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/7ccc94b314e6a6be82c74a30fae70053d4b97b0b.png"][/img][/p][p]Each ritual consumes a specific amount of Faith and items.[/p][list][*][p]Once activated, a ritual runs in cycles:If required resources are available at the start of the next cycle, it will continue automatically.[/p][/*][*][p]If not, it will pause until supplies are replenished.[/p][/*][/list][p]Tower Masters, make the most of these systems and explore all the possibilities this towering vertical world has to offer![/p][p][/p][h2]Vertical Garden[/h2][p]In the haven tower, a Towertizen’s Spirit determines their quality of life—and can even change the home they live in.[/p][p]When a Towertizen’s Spirit reaches the upgrade threshold, their entire home will be transformed from a humble Hut into a sturdy Brick House, increasing its capacity and expanding its Work Range.[/p][p]Spirit is made up of six different needs. While fulfilling any of these needs can raise Spirit, in the early days—when resources are scarce—the most cost-effective approach is to improve the Environment in residential areas.[/p][p]This is where the Green House shines: not only does it quickly raise residents’ Spirit, but with clever placement, multiple Green Houses can stack their Environment bonuses for maximum effect.[/p][p]And as a little EA sneak peek, we’re also revealing the upgraded version of the Green House—check out the in-game model and concept art for the Vertical Garden![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/607497b81b487b5f8655f8ab2129b1f35355a4cc.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s all for today’s update! We’re heading back to our work, but if you have anything you’d like to discuss — or chat about with other Tower Masters — feel free to leave a comment below, or join our official Discord Server:[/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/sfXVUFRzP7"]https://discord.com/invite/sfXVUFRzP7[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Follow us to stay tuned with us！[/b] ⬇️⬇️⬇️[/p]

notes.title: See You at BitSummit + A Peek at What’s Next for Stario: Haven Tower
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Tower Architects![/p][p]We have some exciting news to share. [b]Stario: Haven Tower[/b] will be playable at [b]BitSummit 2025 in Kyoto, Japan (July 18–20)[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/1e8284f2f8261355640652c26d048169e590a948.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, we have added full [b]Japanese localisation[/b]! You can already switch to Japanese in the current demo.[/p][p]Since our first demo launch, we've been working intensively on developing new content. We've also gathered a lot of feedback from players and have been optimizing and expanding the game based on the suggestions we've received.[/p][p]If you have not tried the demo yet, you can try it out here:
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387080/STARIO_Haven_Tower_Demo/"] [/url][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387080/STARIO_Haven_Tower_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1][b]A Few Questions We've Been Seeing[/b][/h1][p]We’ve noticed some recurring questions from the community and wanted to take a moment to address a few of them here.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]“When will the game be released?”[/b][/h2][p]This is easily the most common question we receive, and we’re grateful for the enthusiasm 🥰! While we’re still deep in development and haven’t locked down a final date yet, we’re currently aiming for an [b]Early Access launch this fall[/b]. We’ll let you know the moment we have something firm to share.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]“What will change from the current demo?”[/b][/h2][p]Since the demo went live, we’ve collected a ton of thoughtful feedback, both through surveys and community discussions. Based on that, here are some key areas we’re focusing on:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]UI Improvements[/b][/h3][p]We received a lot of comments around font size, color contrast, layout, and clarity. In earlier updates, we introduced a new UI category filter that lets you view different tower data (resources, citizens, food, etc.). For the EA version, we’ll continue refining the visual design, adding clearer icons, and improving overall usability.
[/p][h3][b]Improved Tutorial Experience[/b][/h3][p]We know that getting started can feel overwhelming, so we’re reworking the tutorial to better explain core systems step-by-step, with clearer guidance and language based on common areas of confusion.
[/p][h3][b]Performance Optimization[/b][/h3][p]Some of you have already pushed the demo to its limits, and we’ve noticed the strain it puts on performance, especially when many UI elements are active. We’re working on several improvements to help the game run more smoothly in later stages of tower construction, so your creativity can really shine.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1][b]What’s Coming in the Early Access Version?[/b][/h1][p]Here’s a quick preview of what’s being added:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Ritual Platforms[/b][/h3][p]A brand-new [b]ritual system[/b] will allow you to shape your gameplay through faith and discovery. By collecting ritual cards in three categories: [b]Aether[/b], [b]Vita[/b], and [b]Fabrik[/b]. You’ll unlock powerful effects through the ritual platform.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/b02e7deee60ea016bd536981f3ad5eca5dbe0191.png"][/img][/p][p]Examples include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Levia Ritual (Aether)[/b]: Lightens gravity, allowing longer horizontal expansion and easier cargo movement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Migrana Ritual (Vita)[/b]: Enables citizens to work across greater vertical distances.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pendara Ritual (Fabrik)[/b]: Increases production as the farther structures extend away from the core. [/p][/*][/list][p]Rituals can also be combined, letting you fine-tune your tower’s strengths and adapt to any challenge.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Miracle Floors[/b][/h3][p]In the face of skyborne disasters and the unknown above, your towertizens may feel lost, but beauty and meaning await. Miracle Floors are special structures that mark key milestones in humanity’s climb. Each one represents not just progress, but a step forward in the shared journey toward the divine.[/p][p]For example, the [b]Fountain of Heaven[/b] transforms the heavy rains of storm zones into valuable energy to help your tower push higher.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/307d36aeda3053e593f6c29d1421c3c96b53b4f1.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Citizen Wishes[/b][/h3][p]Ever wonder what your towertizens are really thinking? In EA, we’re introducing a [b]Wish Wall[/b] system where citizens post personal desires. Fulfilling these wishes will raise overall happiness and sometimes unlock a few heartfelt surprises.[/p][p]More than just workers or production units, your citizens are the soul of each tower. Beyond the strategy and systems, we hope players feel the human warmth that binds everyone together in this vertical nation.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]If you run into any issues while playing or have suggestions for the game, we’d love to hear from you. Feel free to leave a comment or join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/sfXVUFRzP7"]Discord server[/url] to chat directly with the dev team and other players. We’re always happy to hear your thoughts![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/240c45e6709e7fc5195ca878b8ad6b8cfa66defe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Stario Dev Team[/p][p]
[/p]

Share the moments that stood out to you, whether it’s:[/p][p]A breathtaking Kowloon Walled City-style mega-structure[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/330a56f7c11d194e34090e5220902888fe65f70e.png"][/img][/p][p]cr. Check out our earlier post here:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3209750/view/503952975653243608?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]In our very first devlog, we shared the inspiration behind [i]STARIO: Haven Tower. notes.title: New Trailer & Coming to the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p][/p][p]After many sleepless nights refining the demo of STARIO: Haven Tower, we're thrilled to finally share it with you! During today’s PC Gaming Show livestream, we unveiled a brand-new trailer, and we're proud to announce our participation in the Steam Next Fest with this new demo![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/8027c8da08b169111473b08f59fbee412d37e2f1.png"][/img][/p][p]Watch the trailer:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/xIoV3zBUm-c"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This new demo lets you build the first 12 layers of your haven tower from the ground up. Brave extreme weather like sandstorms, fog, and heavy rain to harness unique skyborne resources, unlock advanced construction technologies, and develop vertical logistics systems. Protect your towertizens, rediscover ancient civilizations, and push the limits of vertical expansion.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387080/_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The updated demo is estimated to have 2 to 3 (or more) hours of playtime. It expands on our core vertical building mechanics by introducing the new horizontal expanding Brace Technology, which reinforces structural stability while allowing for more flexible and expansive skyward designs. Use it to shape your tower into a breathtaking architectural marvel.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/b57ba876c8b4c0c47784976259fd77dda81efb59.gif"][/img][/p][p]As you stack brick upon brick toward the stars, remember: your towertizens’ needs grow with the tower. From basic survival to emotional well-being, upgrading their quality of life is key to productivity. Watch as they scurry between layers, celebrating every milestone with joy and awe.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/32dcd84d4e32c69954f50c508f5a3bed31815a5e.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Note to returning players:[/b][/p][p][b]The new demo is not compatible with save files from before June 5. If you'd like to continue an older save, you can revert to the previous version by right-clicking the game in your Steam library, selecting Betas, and switching to the “v0.1.7_legacy” branch.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]For full details on what’s new in the demo and how to switch versions, check out this post: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3209750/view/503952975653240970"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Want to give feedback directly or share your tower builds with other players? Join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/sfXVUFRzP7"][u]Discord[/u][/url], where you’ll also find exclusive community events (with rewards)![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/240c45e6709e7fc5195ca878b8ad6b8cfa66defe.png"][/img][/p][p]May your bricks and dedication give rise to a civilization that pierces the sky, against all odds.
[/p][p]Stargate Games[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update on Jun 6 & Save Data Notice

notes.title: Devlog #1 Wonders above Sky
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, my future friends. I’m the developer from Stargate Games, and the director of STARIO: Haven Tower.[/h3]

This is my first Devlog, so I want to introduce the very beginning of the “tower game”.

Why a “tower”? Does it relate to a specific tower? Well, the idea comes from an Architecture class when I was in university. So, it’s not about any famous tower in the physical world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/5e7e3c24aa4d06e5d27db2071ae3348faf7575a9.png[/img]
[i](Pictures of our classwork.)[/i]

We had a topic on “A thousand-meter-tall settlement”. The dimension of it is 600M (L) * 600M (W) * 1000M (H). And we are asked to discuss the issues of this vertical tower-city – the opposition of city and countryside on this city; the development of the city…
This topic has been on my mind till today. I was not merely intrigued by the macro perspective on this project, my thoughts are mostly about some underlying issues:

[b][i]- What’s living on a high vertical tower be like?
- Would people have vertigo living on higher levels?
- How long would people wait for the elevators?
- Would there be sky-viewing houses over a sea of clouds?
- Would people have anoxia due to thin air?[/i][/b]

One day, I found some ideas on these questions in a game.
I was playing The Twilight Forest Mod in Minecraft and there is a sky-high tree in the game. It’s a hollow tree, with about 3m2 space inside. There are vines growing inside, allowing me to climb up and down.
So, I make my home inside the tree.

Because of the limited horizontal space, I’ll have to build my stuff vertically.
From the living room at the highest position, I put stove, workbench, growing area, farms, storage, enchanting area, spoils of wars and showcases each level below.
I dug holes every couple level, to build a viewing platform hanging outside the big tree.

The scale of this tower city is not as big as I imagined, but it’s relatively big in this game. It was a refreshing experience, making my fantasy fulfilled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/e222bfd8385d90c29be1eb33dcb17811a6498699.jpg[/img]
[i](A tree house I made in Minecraft)[/i]

Today, I’m still attracted by all kinds of towers in this world ---
The megastructures in other fantasy stories,
The lighthouse the protagonist was training in from the film TENET,
The endlessly expanding and all-inclusive skyscraper from the Library of Babel,
and the giant tower from the Tower of Babylon by Ted Chiang, and I shall quote a few lines from it:

[quote=Tower of Babylon] [i]After dinner, he asked Kudda and his family, “Have any of you ever visited Babylon?”
Kudda’s wife, Alitum, answered, “No, why would we? It’s a long climb, and we have all we need here.”
“You have no desire to actually walk on the earth?”
Kudda shrugged. “We live on the road to heaven; all the work that we do is to extend it further. When we leave the tower, we will take the upward ramp, not the downward.”[/i] [/quote]

And I have a lot of pictures collected, of towers, of skyscrapers, of giant vertical structures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/798e451e443e370ca15ff2ebb5c90053ece63447.png[/img]
[i](Here is some of my collections for reference.)[/i]

So, I started thinking about doing something on this idea.
For the spectacularity, the curiosity of life, and the answer for that topic 10 years ago.
For the imagination and great expectations mankind having for the skies, I started this project. 

That’s how everything comes together.

In the next Devlog, I’ll talk about the design, gameplay and logics of this game.
Until next time.
